name: Butterfly Spy
source:
A fairy spy infiltrating a group of insurgents meets a handsome rebel. Will they choose their mission or their heart?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一名潜入叛军组织卧底的妖精间谍，邂逅了一位英俊迷人的反抗军青年。面对任务与真心，这位间谍究竟会作何抉择？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
